name: App shell with sidebar
keywords: layout navigation sidebar app shell saas dashboard admin
use_when: More than 5 top-level sections in an app
key_rules: Collapsible to icons; current item highlighted; group related items; drawer on mobile; persist collapsed state
a11y: nav landmark; aria-current=page; keyboard reachable toggle
anti_patterns: Deep nesting > 2 levels; icon-only without tooltips/labels

name: Command palette
keywords: command palette cmd k search actions keyboard power users
use_when: Apps with many actions or entities
key_rules: Fuzzy search actions + entities; recent items; show shortcuts; open with Ctrl/Cmd+K
a11y: combobox + listbox pattern; focus trapped in dialog; announce result count
anti_patterns: Only way to reach features; no discoverable alternative

name: Data table
keywords: table grid rows columns sort filter pagination bulk spreadsheet list
key_rules: Sticky header; sortable columns; column visibility; row actions; saved views; virtualize > ~200 complex rows; tabular numbers
a11y: table semantics or grid pattern; sort state via aria-sort; row selection announced
anti_patterns: Horizontal scroll hiding key columns; truncation without tooltip/expand

name: Filters and facets
keywords: filters facets refine search sidebar chips catalog
key_rules: State in URL; show counts; applied filters as removable chips; clear all; instant apply on desktop, apply button on mobile sheet
a11y: fieldsets with legends; live region for result count
anti_patterns: Filters that reset on back navigation; zero-result dead ends

name: Search with autocomplete
keywords: search autocomplete typeahead suggestions query instant
use_when: Users know roughly what they want
key_rules: Debounce 150-300ms; highlight match; recent + popular; keyboard navigation; show no-results help
a11y: combobox pattern (APG); aria-activedescendant; announce suggestions
anti_patterns: Firing request per keystroke without cancel; stealing focus

name: KPI cards
keywords: kpi metrics stats cards summary dashboard numbers
key_rules: Value + delta + period + sparkline; consistent units; explain metric on hover/tap; tabular nums
a11y: Delta conveyed with text/icon not color only
anti_patterns: Too many KPIs (> 6); unlabeled deltas

name: Date range picker
keywords: date range calendar picker period filter booking
use_when: Filtering by time or booking stays
key_rules: Presets (Today, 7d, 30d, custom); typed input allowed; show timezone; disable unavailable dates with reason
a11y: Grid calendar pattern; full keyboard; label inputs
anti_patterns: Picker-only input with no typing; ambiguous date formats

name: Live data indicator
keywords: realtime live updating stream last updated status
key_rules: Show live/paused state and last-updated time; pause on interaction; batch updates; new-items pill instead of jumping
a11y: aria-live polite for summaries only; don't announce every tick
anti_patterns: Content jumping under cursor; silent stale data

name: Empty state
keywords: empty state no data first run onboarding zero results
use_when: No content yet or no results
key_rules: Explain why it's empty; one primary action; sample data or template option
a11y: Heading + text, not image-only
anti_patterns: Blank screens; generic 'No data' with no next step

name: Onboarding checklist
keywords: onboarding activation checklist setup getting started
use_when: New users must complete setup steps
key_rules: 3-6 steps; show progress; dismissible; deep-link each step; celebrate completion subtly
a11y: Progress conveyed in text; focus management on step completion
anti_patterns: Forced product tours that block the UI

name: Settings pages
keywords: settings preferences account profile billing configuration
key_rules: Group by mental model; explicit save or autosave with confirmation; danger zone separated
a11y: Form labels; status messages announced
anti_patterns: Mixed autosave and save buttons on one page

name: Product grid
keywords: product grid catalog listing cards ecommerce shop
key_rules: Consistent image aspect ratio; price + key variant info; quick add; wishlist; lazy-load below fold only
a11y: Card link is one focusable element; alt text describes product
anti_patterns: Hover-only info; layout shift from images

name: Product detail page
keywords: pdp product detail page gallery variants add to cart
key_rules: Gallery with zoom; clear price; variant selector with availability; sticky add-to-cart on mobile; delivery + returns info near CTA
a11y: Radio group for variants; alt for gallery images; announce cart updates
anti_patterns: Hidden total cost; unavailable variants without explanation

name: Mini cart drawer
keywords: cart drawer basket mini cart side panel
key_rules: Opens on add; shows item, subtotal, checkout CTA; easy quantity edit; continue shopping
a11y: Dialog pattern; focus moves in and returns; Escape closes
anti_patterns: Auto-closing too fast; blocking full-page modal

name: Checkout
keywords: checkout payment shipping address order purchase
key_rules: Guest checkout; minimal fields; address autocomplete; express pay; show summary and total early; inline validation; preserve input on error
a11y: autocomplete attributes; error summary linked to fields; no time limits without extension
anti_patterns: Forced account creation; surprise fees at last step

name: Hero section
keywords: hero landing header above the fold headline cta
use_when: First screen of a marketing page
key_rules: One headline (value), one sub-line, one primary CTA, supporting visual; LCP image prioritized
a11y: Real text not text-in-image; sufficient contrast over imagery
anti_patterns: Carousels/sliders in hero; multiple competing CTAs

name: Social proof
keywords: testimonials logos reviews ratings trust social proof
key_rules: Real logos/quotes with names and roles; specific outcomes; place near CTAs
a11y: Logo images need alt (company name)
anti_patterns: Fake-looking stock testimonials; unreadable logo walls

name: Pricing table
keywords: pricing plans tiers subscription comparison
key_rules: 3 tiers max visible; highlight recommended; monthly/annual toggle with savings; feature comparison table below
a11y: Toggle is a real switch/radio; table semantics for comparison
anti_patterns: Hidden prices; comparison only via icons

name: FAQ
keywords: faq questions answers accordion objections
key_rules: Group by topic; concise answers; link to docs; searchable if > 15
a11y: Accordion with button headers, aria-expanded
anti_patterns: Hiding essential info (pricing, refunds) only in FAQ

name: Feature bento
keywords: features bento grid showcase benefits
key_rules: Each tile = one benefit + visual; vary tile size by importance
a11y: Logical DOM order
anti_patterns: Purely decorative tiles with no message

name: Lead / signup form
keywords: form signup waitlist lead contact newsletter
key_rules: Ask for the minimum; single column; clear privacy note; success state; spam protection without hostile CAPTCHA
a11y: Labels; error messages; accessible CAPTCHA alternative
anti_patterns: Placeholder-only labels; resetting form on error

name: Infinite feed
keywords: feed infinite scroll timeline posts cursor pagination
key_rules: Cursor pagination; virtualize; 'new posts' pill; restore scroll position; footer reachable or load-more
a11y: Announce loaded items count; keyboard way to skip feed
anti_patterns: Auto-inserting new items at top; unreachable footer

name: Composer
keywords: composer input message post editor chat reply
key_rules: Autosize; draft persistence; attachments with progress; Enter vs Shift+Enter documented; optimistic send with retry
a11y: Labelled textbox; announce send status
anti_patterns: Losing drafts on navigation

name: Notifications
keywords: notifications inbox alerts bell activity toast
key_rules: Inbox with read/unread; grouping; preferences; toasts for transient success only
a11y: aria-live for toasts; toasts not the only record
anti_patterns: Toasts for errors that need action; notification spam

name: Profile page
keywords: profile user account page bio avatar
key_rules: Clear identity header; primary action (follow/message); tabs for content types
a11y: Tabs pattern; alt for avatar
anti_patterns: Hiding key actions in overflow menu

name: List-detail split
keywords: list detail master detail inbox email tickets split view
key_rules: Split view on desktop, stacked on mobile; keyboard j/k navigation; keep list position
a11y: Landmarks for both panes; announce selected item
anti_patterns: Losing list scroll position when opening detail

name: Bulk actions
keywords: bulk select multiple actions batch table
key_rules: Select all on page vs all results explicit; action bar appears on selection; undo for destructive actions
a11y: Checkbox labels; announce selection count
anti_patterns: Destructive bulk actions without confirmation/undo

name: Multi-step form / wizard
keywords: wizard stepper multi-step form onboarding application
key_rules: Show steps and progress; save drafts; allow back without data loss; validate per step; review step before submit
a11y: Step status in text; focus to step heading on change
anti_patterns: Losing data on back; validation only at the end

name: Audit log / activity history
keywords: audit log history activity timeline changes compliance
key_rules: Filter by actor/date/type; human-readable diffs; export
a11y: Table or list semantics; timestamps in accessible format
anti_patterns: Raw JSON dumps as UI

name: Map + list split
keywords: map list split view locations nearby search area
key_rules: Sync hover/selection between list and map; search-this-area; cluster markers; list is primary on mobile
a11y: List mirrors map content for keyboard/screen reader users
anti_patterns: Map-only information

name: Streaming AI response
keywords: streaming ai response llm tokens chat generation
key_rules: Stable layout while streaming; stop/regenerate; render markdown safely; show sources; batch DOM updates per frame
a11y: aria-busy while generating; announce completion not each token
anti_patterns: Rendering raw HTML from model output; auto-scrolling away from user

name: Editor toolbar
keywords: toolbar editor formatting tools canvas
key_rules: Group related tools; show shortcuts in tooltips; contextual toolbars near selection
a11y: Toolbar pattern with roving tabindex; labelled icon buttons
anti_patterns: Unlabelled icon buttons

name: Contextual properties panel
keywords: inspector properties panel sidebar design tool
use_when: Editing properties of a selected object
key_rules: Show only relevant properties; inline numeric scrubbing + typed input
a11y: Form semantics; labels for every control
anti_patterns: Panels that cover the canvas on small screens

name: Version history
keywords: version history undo revisions restore
use_when: Users need to recover past states
key_rules: Named versions; preview before restore; restore creates new version
a11y: List semantics; keyboard restore
anti_patterns: Destructive restore without confirmation

name: Table of contents
keywords: toc table of contents docs article navigation anchors
key_rules: Sticky on desktop; highlight current section; collapsible on mobile
a11y: nav with aria-label; aria-current for active
anti_patterns: TOC that scrolls independently and hides content

name: Article layout
keywords: article reading blog post typography long form
key_rules: 60-75ch measure; clear headings; reading time; code blocks with copy; related content at end
a11y: Heading hierarchy; skip link
anti_patterns: Sidebars squeezing the measure; tiny body text

name: Newsletter signup
keywords: newsletter subscribe email signup
key_rules: Single email field; clear value and frequency; double opt-in confirmation
a11y: Label and status message
anti_patterns: Exit-intent popups covering content

name: Case study grid
keywords: portfolio projects case studies work grid showcase
key_rules: Strong cover images; role + outcome on cards; filter by type
a11y: Alt text; card is one link
anti_patterns: Image-only cards with no text

name: Bottom tab bar
keywords: bottom navigation tabs mobile app pwa
key_rules: 3-5 items; icon + label; active state; respect safe-area insets
a11y: nav landmark; aria-current
anti_patterns: More than 5 items; hiding labels

name: Offline banner
keywords: offline network status connectivity pwa sync
key_rules: Non-blocking banner; queue actions; show sync status; retry automatically
a11y: aria-live polite status
anti_patterns: Blocking modal on every disconnect

name: Pull to refresh
keywords: pull to refresh mobile feed reload
use_when: Mobile feeds where users expect it
key_rules: Native-feeling threshold; show progress; also provide a refresh button
a11y: Button alternative for non-touch users
anti_patterns: Using it on non-list screens
